general.scope: All naturally labelled templates of sizes 2..5; every incomparable unordered pair; module sizes (2,2),(2,3),(3,2),(3,3). Full overlap fibres only for templates <=4 and sizes (3,3).
general.limitations: One bitmask template encoding. These checks do not replace the injective/FKG proof or external review.

uniform_words.scope: Word populations p<=25,q<=25; symmetric population halves M<=50; exact displayed constant checks.

central_finite_core.shared_inputs: Same template and finite domain; three-chain edge flow vs ten-module direct event recurrence. Not external independent review.

proof_dependency: Only central_finite_core is a necessary finite component of the all-t central slice. General theorems have written analytic proofs, independent of these finite checks.
archive: The S76 conversation ZIP preserves complete optional scripts, CSV outputs and process logs. GitHub preserves the proof, report, full witness fractions, necessary finite-core scripts and this scope summary.
